record.title: Guideline for the Use of Generative AI in Primary and Secondary Education
record.original_title: 初等中等教育段階における生成AIの利活用に関するガイドライン
record.short_title: MEXT Guideline on Generative AI in Schools (Ver.2.0)
record.issuing_body: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (Elementary and Secondary Education Bureau)
record.summary: Guideline of the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology for teachers, school staff and boards of education on the appropriate use of generative AI in primary and secondary schools; it does not uniformly ban or mandate its use. It sets a human-centred approach in which people make the final judgement and take responsibility, and five points for school use: proper use considering safety, including providers' terms of service, age limits and parental consent; information security; protection of personal information, privacy and copyright; fairness and attention to bias; and transparency and accountability to stakeholders.
record.notes: Version 2.0 of 26 Dec 2024 revised the provisional guideline that MEXT published in July 2023 (初等中等教育段階における生成AIの利用に関する暫定的なガイドライン, Ver.1.0), after discussion in a study group on generative AI in primary and secondary education set up in July 2024. MEXT's notices to boards of education on the provisional guideline and on its revision are dated 4 Jul 2023 and 26 Dec 2024. Reference materials include checklists by scenario and examples from generative AI pilot schools. For safety measures by AI developers and providers, the guideline refers to the AI Guidelines for Business and J-AISI's evaluation guide.
record.scope_note: Mainly guidance on using generative AI in teaching and school administration; included because it sets safety, privacy and age-restriction safeguards for children's use of generative AI.

verification.note: Stored: MEXT's page on the use of generative AI (mext.go.jp), the Japanese main text of Ver.2.0 (33 pages, 文部科学省 初等中等教育局, 令和６年 12 月 26 日), MEXT's English provisional translation ('Please refer to the original text for accuracy') and the English one-page summary. They confirm the title, the issuer, Ver.2.0 of 26 December 2024, the provisional guideline (ver1.0) of July 2023 (令和 5 年 7 月) and the content; the summary is written from the Japanese text, with terms as MEXT's translation renders them. date_published keeps the month the official sources give for the provisional guideline; the notice dated 4 July 2023 is in notes.

legal_force.quote: 学校現場での生成 AI の利活用を一律に禁止した り義務付けたりするものではない。

legal_force.locator: page 4, Positioning and structure of the guidelines
legal_force.quote: They summarize fundamental principles and key points to consider when using such technology, and do not uniformly ban or obligate using generative AI in schools.

judgment.status_reasoning: Ver.2.0 of 26 December 2024 is the current version on MEXT's page; it is a reference that neither bans nor obliges use, so non-binding and current.
judgment.scope_reasoning: Borderline: its main subject is the educational use of generative AI, but it sets safeguards for children (terms of service, age limits, parental consent, privacy, bias). Included with a scope_note.
judgment.date_reasoning: Following the register's convention for versioned guidelines (JP-02, JP-03), date_published is the first version (the provisional guideline, July 2023, 令和5年7月) and date_last_updated the current Ver.2.0 (26 Dec 2024). The page gives only the month for the July 2023 publication; the notice to boards of education is dated 4 July 2023 (in notes).

open_questions: A checker may prefer to treat Ver.2.0 alone as the instrument (date_published 2024-12-26, the 2023 provisional guideline in notes).
